reason: My right knee has hurt and swelled after a soccer kick.
diagnosis: Medial collateral ligament sprain of the right knee, suggested by direct lateral knee trauma with immediate medial pain, tenderness, swelling/redness, and pain with valgus stress with mild laxity but preserved range of motion and normal gait.
keyPoints: Mechanism of injury: direct blow during sport, side of impact, immediate symptoms
Pain location and quality: medial knee pain, severity, radiation, aggravating movements
Swelling, redness, warmth, bruising, and ability to bear weight/walk
Instability, giving way, locking, popping, or reduced range of motion
Red flags for associated injury: posterior/lateral pain, effusion, neurovascular symptoms, calf pain
Past knee injuries and relevant sports/activity level
manner: calm, cooperative, mildly concerned, wants advice
